notes.title: Upcoming delisting (compensation details in prior notice)
notes.content:
We have reached a consensus with our partners, and Steam has approved that we will delist this week. Thank you very much for your continued support and criticism! Once again, please remind everyone that players who have purchased the existing version can refer to https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3586250/view/530978642895832934 for details on how to obtain the key for the remastered version.

We also hope that you can add a wishlist for our remastered version, which is very helpful to us:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846190/_/

In addition, you don’t have to worry about the games in your library, they will always exist and be updated. The game is just no longer on sale and has become out of print.

Thank you again for your support!
Empire Game Team

notes.title: Apology and Notice of Remastered Version(Existing players keep access + updates)
notes.content:
Dear players,
Our game has been out for over twenty days. First, thank you all for your support and criticism. As this is our first time developing a Steam game, our understanding was insufficient, leading to poor reviews. We sincerely apologize for the strong "mobile port" feel of the game at launch! Upon discovering the issues early after release, we immediately began a comprehensive remaster of the entire game, which is now nearing completion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585310/28e3ca10e5949c049518d2e75abbcd7b8c5792ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585310/873290dc4129630dfb40d9fab1c254136cd5aadb.png[/img]

Additionally, due to unresolved responsibilities and rights issues with a partner, we have created a new store page 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846190/Pixel_Hero/

Players who have purchased [Empire Game], please take a screenshot of your Steam library showing [Empire Game] selected, displaying your playtime and your Steam ID in the top right corner (As shown in the figure below), and send it to: dgyx0011@163.com. We will then send you a key for the new version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585310/978c3db31dbea43d8ca155c500445195bd16415d.png[/img]

If you prefer not to send the screenshot, don't worry. We are working to resolve the issues with our partner as quickly as possible and will continue updating [Empire Game].

Our current work includes, but is not limited to: modifying the controls and UI to eliminate the strong "mobile feel"; fixing bugs; adding new races, heroes, and more. Once development is complete, we will start fresh. Owners of [Empire Game] need not worry; we will update the game immediately upon completion. After resolving the issues with our partner, we will prioritize updating the content and then delist the old version. (Don't worry, we have consulted with Steam. The game will not disappear from your library; it will simply no longer be sold. The old version will become a collector's item, and you will lose nothing. We will also provide you with a key for the new version.)
If you haven't purchased our game yet but are still interested, we hope you will follow our new page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846190/Pixel_Hero/
We would be grateful if you could add it to your wishlist and await our transformation!

Finally, we apologize once again. We are not abandoning the project. Due to disagreements with our partner, we are temporarily unable to update the original version. To protect your rights, we created this alternative solution. We will strive to do better.

notes.title: Launch Day Fixes & Thank You
notes.content:
Thank you for your support on our first day! We've seen all your feedback and have fixed issues as quickly as possible. As a studio starting from mobile games, we're still learning about Steam. We're actively studying the platform and player preferences to create a game everyone will love. Please bear with us for any current imperfections – we'll keep polishing the game.  

【Removed Invites/Group Mechanics + Optimizations】
 1. Removed forced invite/group-join requirements  
 2. Default fullscreen mode on launch  
 3. Fixed resolution-switching failures  
 4. Fixed mouse wheel scrolling both UI and scene simultaneously  
 5. Added 2560×1140, 3840×2160, 4096×2160 resolutions  
6. Removed misclick-prone hero list shortcut; reduced avatar touch area to prevent accidental deselection  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585310/2d8b44d9ff0072f3c6b647bebd12ee1b727cc0f4.png[/img]
 Thank you again for your support!

notes.content: [p][/p][p]1. Removing parts of the invitation and group adding[/p][p]2. Modify to default full screen when opening the game[/p][p]3. Fixed the ineffective situation when cutting different resolutions.[/p][p]4. Fix the situation that the mouse wheel will scroll the scene and the interface at the same time[/p][p]5. Add 2560*1140, 3840*2160, 4096*2160 three resolutions[/p][p]6. Remove the middle hero avatar list to directly enter the entrance of the hero attribute page, and at the same time reduce the touch range of the hero's avatar to avoid the situation of accidentally touching and cancelling the selected state.[/p]
